- (none recorded)

## Gotchas / notes
- The draft uses `rememberSaveable(saver = SendUpdateDraft.Saver)`; collect `camera.recoveredPhotos()` to receive photos when Android recreates the activity; delete unsent photos with `OnScreenCleared`, not `DisposableEffect`.
- Tested on a Xiaomi M2003J15SC (Android 12/MIUI): when the process is killed while the camera is open, the photo and text are still recovered. The workspace (Session) is saved with the back stack (`RestoreSessionAfterProcessDeath` in App.kt), so the restored G2 still belongs to Pema Care.
- A successful send calls `camera.markSaved(path)` (in `SendUpdateDraft.submit`): the photo stops being a draft and is deleted on the next process start.
